title: Reuse the signed-in state
summary: auth.setup.ts is provided. Write tests that start already signed in via storageState: open the dashboard directly and call /api/me with the same session.
why: This is what makes large suites fast: hundreds of tests skip the login form. page.request shares the browser's cookies, so API calls are authenticated too.
objectives: Open /dashboard directly and assert the greeting
page.request.get('/api/me') is OK and returns qa@example.com
hints: Do not fill the login form in these tests.
pitfalls: Logging in again in every test (slow, couples every test to the login page).
Sharing one account across parallel tests that change user data.
teachAlong: Cause: storageState loads the saved cookie.
Effect: the dashboard opens without a login step.
Gate: login-form code in this file fails the task.

requires.name: storageState
requires.reason: Load the saved session with test.use({ storageState: 'playwright/.auth/user.json' }).
You logged in through the form again. Reuse the saved session via storageState — that is what keeps large suites fast.
